title: LineupRL: Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Time Series Captioning via Caption-to-Series Identification

claim.summary: LineupRL post-trains a VLM time series captioner with RLOO, rewarding each caption by how often a frozen text-only LLM verifier picks the described series, printed as raw values, out of statistic-matched real distractors.

modules.name: Caption-to-series identification RLVR
modules.scope_reason: RLOO updates the captioner's weights under a frozen-verifier identification reward, so the contribution changes the model policy; the verifier acts only during training, not as a runtime check.
evidence_locators: PDF p.2; passage beginning "In this work, we propose"
PDF p.3; passage beginning "The reward is caption-to-series identification"
